title: Overdue Receivables Analysis
summary: This note details an instance where the San Jose office faced a serious cash flow issue due to significant overdue invoices. The owner segmented the data, identified the new construction line of business as disproportionately high, and conducted interviews to find root causes. Based on this combined data, the owner presented three approved solutions that resulted in a 15% drop in AR.

key_points.text: $7 million in invoices that were unpaid & significantly overdue represented 33% of total AR
New construction line of business accounted for 55% of the overdue AR
PM’s were not getting notified when invoices were sent out
Regional collectors were spread too thin
Liens were not being filed strategically

related.title: Otis Project Management
related.why: This note details the owner's role as a project manager at Otis, which is the company where the AR issue occurred.
